title: Introduce preflight artifact signer, slim toolchain images, and interleaved lint slices
author: Samir Gupta
release_notes: Adds a preflight artifact signing step for release artifacts, swaps CI runners to use slim toolchain images to reduce surface area and cache size, and splits lint into interleaved slices for faster feedback. No API changes.
description: Context: Our release pipeline occasionally produces unsigned staging artifacts when ephemeral runners pick up partial build caches; CI images have grown large (toolchain images >3GB) which slows cold starts, and lint runs are a single long shard that blocks early feedback. Motivation: reduce blast radius for unsigned artifacts, shorten PR feedback loop, and shrink runner start time and cache churn. Summary of changes: 1) Preflight artifact signer: a new lightweight job 'ci/preflight-sign' runs after build artifacts land in the ephemeral artifact bucket; it verifies checksums, signs artifacts with our ephemeral KMS key, and writes a signing-metadata JSON artifact. The job is gated by a new OPA policy to prevent unsigned artifacts from progressing to the release lane. 2) Slim toolchain images: refactored Dockerfiles into a two-stage build producing a minimal runtime image for CI jobs that don't need full toolchain; images reduced from ~3.2GB to ~420MB for most lanes. Image build is now hermetic and pushed to our internal registry with immutable tags. 3) Interleaved lint slices: lint pipeline split into four independent slices (typescript, python, go, scripts) that run in parallel with an interleaver that surfaces the first failing slice to PR authors. Added a lightweight 'quick-lint' that runs fast heuristics to catch the most common failures immediately. 4) Repo hygiene: removed deprecated node global installs, consolidated lockfile resolution to a single 'lock-resolver' job, and added a cron job that prunes stale dependency branches older than 90 days. Checklist: - [x] Add preflight signer job and OPA policy - [x] Implement signer CLI and document env vars - [x] Replace heavy toolchain images with slim builds and push pipeline - [x] Split lint into interleaved slices + quick-lint - [x] Add cron prune job and lock-resolver consolidation - [x] Update developer docs and quickstart - [x] Add rollout & rollback steps Testing: Local integration against staging registry, ran full CI on branch (see ci_checks below), deployed images to staging region, exercised canary release flow to validate signer gating. Rollout plan: Merge to main -> staged rollout to nightly channel for 48h -> enable signer gating for release channel -> promote to canary -> full release. If signer shows spurious rejections, revert gating by disabling OPA rule and re-run signer job. Migration notes: No changes required for SDK consumers. Release artifacts now include signature metadata; release automation consumes the metadata if present but falls back to legacy path for 7 days after rollout. Security: Signer uses the ephemeral KMS key stored in the CI secrets; key rotation doc updated and HSM rotation planned in follow-up (ENG-9020).

review_comments: Maya Chen: Can the signer job be retried idempotently? Please ensure the metadata write is atomic.
Samir Gupta: Yes — signer writes to a temp key + rename pattern; added a test case to the signer unit tests (see commit a1b7c3).
Diego Martinez: Slim images look good; curious about GHA runner cache miss on node14 — did you bump node versions?
Samir Gupta: We consolidated to node16 LTS for slim images and documented the change in the quickstart. Added fallback step for older branches.
Ruth Alvarez: OPA policy looks strict; suggest a diagnostic flag to bypass for emergency releases.
Samir Gupta: Added an emergency bypass flag guarded by the 'release-admin' team role in OPA and logged fallback actions.
Maya Chen: CI flakiness when cache warmup fails — add a prewarm artifact step.
Samir Gupta: Added prewarm step and fallback to network pull for rare cache misses.
Diego Martinez: Approved after addressing idempotency and prewarm (LGTM).
rollout_plan: Staged rollout: main -> nightly (48h) -> enable signer gating on release channel -> canary 4% traffic (24h) -> full release. Revert gating by toggling OPA rule or disabling signer via CI toggle.
notes_for_ops: If signer job fails at scale, look at signer pod logs (tools/signer) and KMS quotas. Slim images are immutable and tagged; if a job fails due to missing image, re-run 'infra/ci/images/push' pipeline to rehydrate registry.
post_merge_tasks: Monitor signer rejection rate via ci.signer.rejections (alert if >0.5% over 30m)
Watch runner cold start time telemetry; rollback slim images if median start >1.2x prior baseline
Run dependency prune dry-run and validate branches targeted before enabling enforced prune
